name: Rinn
description: Rinn was a frozen planet located in the Baxel sector of the Outer Rim. Inhabitants of Rinn depended on heaters to live in the freezing conditions. In 4 BBY, the planet experienced an energy crisis when they ran low on power generators, causing the rebels of Phoenix Cell to assist them.
lead_paragraphs: Rinn was a frozen planet located in the Baxel sector of the Outer Rim. Inhabitants of Rinn depended on heaters to live in the freezing conditions.
